title: Plop 26.4
content: Plop Linux is an independently-developed Linux distribution for desktops and servers, available for the i486, x86_64 and armv6l architectures. It is designed for advanced Linux users. The distribution does not include a package manager; installing new software is done by compiling it from source code. The desktop edition of the Plop Linux ships with the Xfce and MATE desktops as well as the Fluxbox window manager. The distribution's server edition comes with basic server software installed, but additional programs, including web servers, databases and programming languages can be easily added from the project's repositories.
